Let me reconsider the game mechanics:
1. The player moves along trails in one direction at a time
2. SPACE teleports the player between trails
3. The player gets stuck at cross centers
Maybe the goal is to SPACE at each cross center to "activate" it, and then the blocks get collected. But I've already SPACEed multiple times without collecting blocks.
Wait, let me reconsider. The player started at (60, 27), which is the bottom of the orange X trail. The player moved UP along the orange trail to (48, 24). Then SPACE teleported to (27, 39), the red cross center. The player moved UP along the red trail to (21, 39). Then SPACE teleported back to (48, 24). Then SPACE teleported to (21, 39). Then the player moved DOWN to (27, 39), the red cross center.
So SPACE seems to toggle between the orange trail and the red trail. But I haven't explored the blue trail yet.
Let me try SPACEing from the red cross center (27, 39) to see if the player teleports to the blue trail.
